one_line: Elder statesman of the Khalsa, who fought to the death at Sobraon in the First Anglo-Sikh War.

appearance.age_look: Late 50s to early 60s, lean but strong, upright posture of a seasoned warrior.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium-tan Punjabi complexion, sharp nose, thick white moustache that curves down, neatly trimmed white beard gathered and tied close to the chin, calm yet intense eyes with a steady, resolute default expression.
appearance.hair: Hair fully covered by a tall, neatly wrapped deep-navy blue turban in mid-19th-century Sikh style, with prominent layered pleats and a small, simple steel quoits-like chakram at the front; no loose hair visible.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Khalsa military dress: a long-sleeved knee-length angarkha-style tunic in rich deep-navy blue cotton with subtle vertical weave, tied at the side with a sash; over this, a sleeveless quilted cotton char-aina style coat in muted steel-grey with simple stitched panels suggesting light armour; a broad mustard-yellow cotton kamarband (waist sash) wraps firmly around his waist with the ends tucked; loose white salwar trousers gathered at the ankles, and sturdy brown leather boots that rise midway up the calf; he wears a simple steel kara bracelet on his right wrist and a plain steel talwar belt across his shoulder, with minimal jewellery befitting a disciplined soldier.
appearance.signature: A single slightly-curved Sikh talwar sword with a plain steel blade, a brass hilt with a disc pommel and a simple knuckle-guard, worn sheathed in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip but often shown drawn and held in his right hand, blade angled downward in a controlled, ready stance.

ref_desc: Sham Singh Attariwala is an older, lean Punjabi Sikh with a white beard tied close, a deep navy-blue turban with a small steel chakram, wearing a deep navy angarkha, steel-grey quilted coat, mustard-yellow sash, white salwar, brown boots, and carrying a brass-hilted talwar sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Sham Singh Attariwala as a dignified elder Khalsa general at Sobraon: an older, lean Punjabi Sikh with medium-tan skin, sharp features, intense eyes, a thick white moustache and a neatly tied white beard close to the chin, wearing a tall deep navy-blue turban with layered pleats and a small steel chakram at the front, dressed in a long-sleeved knee-length deep navy cotton angarkha tunic tied at the side, over which sits a sleeveless quilted steel-grey coat suggesting light armour, a broad mustard-yellow cotton waist sash firmly wrapped around his middle, loose white salwar trousers gathered at the ankles, and sturdy mid-calf brown leather boots, with a simple steel kara bracelet on his right wrist and a plain cross-shoulder sword belt; show his signature slightly-curved Sikh talwar with a plain steel blade and brass hilt in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip and also in his hand in one pose, held in a controlled downward angle, and ensure the palette emphasizes deep navy, mustard yellow, white, steel grey, and brown leather while keeping the overall look historically grounded and fully modestly clothed.
